map.最小公倍数 lcm(a,b) 是能同时被 a、b 整除的最小正整数；本页按 lc: The least common multiple lcm(a,b) is the smallest positive integer divisible by both a and b; this page recurses with lcm(a,b)=|a·b|/gcd(a,b), merges multiple inputs in turn, truncates with parseInt and rejects 0.
map.最小公倍数 lcm(a,b) 是同时能被 a 和 b 整除的最小正整数。计算口径: The least common multiple lcm(a,b) is the smallest positive integer divisible by both a and b. Computation: lcm(a,b)=|a·b| / gcd(a,b); for three or more values it recurses as lcm(a,b,c)=lcm(lcm(a,b),c). An equivalent method is prime factorization taking the highest power of each prime. This page shows the recursion step by step, truncates inputs with parseInt and rejects 0.
map.0 没有最小公倍数（任何正整数都不是 0 的倍数意义上的最小正公倍数），页面直接: 0 has no least common multiple (no positive integer is the smallest positive common multiple of 0 in the usual sense), so the page rejects inputs containing 0. Negatives are taken as absolute values; decimals are truncated by parseInt (1.5 becomes 1), so enter integers. Pitfall 1: taking a×b as the lcm - that holds only when the two numbers are coprime (gcd=1), otherwise the result is too large. Pitfall 2: swapping lcm and gcd: lcm is the smallest positive number divisible by both, gcd the largest number dividing both. With very large inputs the product may exceed the safe integer range, and since the page displays JS numbers, engineering use should switch to BigInt.
map.4, 6：gcd = 2 ⇒ lcm = (4×6)/2 = 12，步骤行完整可: 4, 6: gcd = 2 ⇒ lcm = (4×6)/2 = 12, with a fully reproducible step line. 8, 9: coprime (gcd = 1) ⇒ lcm = 72 = 8×9, confirming that the product is the lcm when coprime. 8, 9, 15: first lcm(8,9) = 72, then lcm(72,15) = (1,080)/3 = 360; prime factorization 2³×3²×5 also gives 360. 12, 18, 24: first lcm(12,18) = 216/6 = 36, then lcm(36,24) = 864/12 = 72; prime factorization 2³×3² also gives 72. 21, 6: gcd = 3 ⇒ lcm = 126/3 = 42, illustrating that the product is not the lcm. 0, 5: the page rejects "cannot contain 0" because 0 has no positive least common multiple.
map.lcm 的典型用法是「让若干周期第一次重新对齐」：分数 1/4 与 1/6 通分: A typical use of lcm is "making several cycles realign for the first time": adding 1/4 and 1/6 uses the denominator lcm(4,6) = 12; two gears with 24 and 36 teeth return to their initial mesh after lcm(24,36) = 72 teeth; if A is inspected every 8 days, B every 9 and C every 15, all three coincide after 360 days. Multiple inputs can simply be comma-separated; order does not matter because the recursion is associative.
map.页面先算 lcm(12,18)：gcd=6 ⇒ (12×18)/6=36；再算: The page first computes lcm(12,18): gcd=6 ⇒ (12×18)/6=36; then lcm(36,24): gcd=12 ⇒ (36×24)/12=72. Prime factorization: 12=2²×3, 18=2×3², 24=2³×3 ⇒ highest powers 2³×3²=72.

map.对正整数 a、b：lcm(a,b)·gcd(a,b)=a·b，因此已知 gcd: For positive integers a and b, lcm(a,b)·gcd(a,b)=a·b, so lcm follows from a known gcd.
map.两两递推即可：先求 lcm(a,b)，再用结果与 c 求 lcm，顺序不影响最终: Pairwise recursion: compute lcm(a,b), then the lcm of that result with c; the order does not change the final result.
map.为什么多值输入的顺序不影响结果？: Why does input order not change the result?
map.lcm 满足结合律：lcm(a,b,c) = lcm(lcm(a,b),c) =: lcm is associative: lcm(a,b,c) = lcm(lcm(a,b),c) = lcm(a,lcm(b,c)); the page recurses left to right, and any other grouping gives the same result.
map.输入一个数会怎样？: What happens with a single input?
map.单值时没有「公倍数」的比较对象，页面直接返回该数本身（与 gcd 的单值处理一致: With one value there is nothing to compare a common multiple against, so the page returns the number itself (consistent with the single-value gcd handling), which is handy for checking that an input was parsed correctly.
